# SilberArrows

> Independent Mercedes-Benz service centre in Al Quoz, Dubai. Established 2011. Specialists in Mercedes-Benz maintenance, repair, diagnostics, performance tuning (authorised RENNtech distributor), and classic Mercedes-Benz models. Genuine parts, factory schedules and XENTRY Diagnosis. 12-month warranty on parts and labour. Free collection and delivery across Dubai.

## Business facts

- Name: SilberArrows
- Location: Al Manara Street, Al Quoz, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Phone: +971 4 380 5515
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/97143805515
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 08:00 to 18:00 (closed Sunday)
- Founded: 2011
- Specialisation: Mercedes-Benz only (no other marques)
- Reviews: 4.7 out of 5 from 509 Google reviews
- Labour rate: AED 375 per hour (excludes Classic, Maybach, McLaren SLR)
- Warranty: 12 months on all parts and labour

## Mercedes-Benz services

- [Scheduled Maintenance — Service A & B](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/scheduled-maintenance): Official Mercedes-Benz Service A (Minor) and Service B (Major) maintenance with genuine parts and XENTRY Diagnosis.
- [Brake Service & Repair](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/brake-service): Brake pad/disc replacement, fluid flush, calliper inspection, EPB recalibration with XENTRY.
- [Air Conditioning Service & Repair](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/air-conditioning): R134a and R1234yf refrigerant service, cabin filter replacement, leak detection.
- [Electrical & Computer Diagnostics](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/diagnostics): XENTRY Diagnosis fault scanning, ECU coding, sensor and wiring repairs.
- [Engine Repair & Overhaul](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/engine-repair): Timing chain, gasket, turbocharger and full engine rebuilds for M271, M272, M276, M278, OM651 and others.
- [Suspension & Steering Repair](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/suspension-repair): Conventional, AIRMATIC and ABC (Active Body Control) suspension repair.
- [Battery Testing & Replacement](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/battery-service): Genuine Mercedes-Benz battery installation with ECU registration.
- [Tyre Replacement & Balancing](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/tyre-replacement): Mercedes-Benz-approved tyres including run-flats and AMG sizes, with TPMS calibration.
- [Wheel Alignment](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/wheel-alignment): Hunter 3D laser four-wheel alignment, approved for AMG and 4MATIC variants.
- [Interior & Exterior Detailing](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/detailing): Paint correction, ceramic coating (Gtechniq), interior shampoo and leather care.

## Speciality areas

- Mercedes-Benz AMG performance models
- Mercedes-Benz Maybach
- Mercedes EQ electric range
- Classic Mercedes-Benz models
- Performance tuning — sole authorised RENNtech distributor in Dubai

## Frequently asked questions

- We are an independent specialist, not a franchised Mercedes-Benz dealer.
- Independent servicing can void or limit the manufacturer factory warranty under typical Mercedes-Benz warranty terms; customers still under factory warranty should confirm with their dealer before booking. SilberArrows backs all its own work with a 12-month warranty on parts and labour.
- Customers typically save 30 to 40 percent on Service A, Service B and major repairs compared with Mercedes-Benz main-dealer pricing.
- Free collection and delivery across Dubai is included with every service.
